notes.title: Marble Escape Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43622421/c6ab44903fb9bb5526b1ddaade0669eea806e6b6.png[/img]


[h1]Marble Escape will be released on 23rd February 2023.[/h1]

The initial release will contain 20 levels + 1 bonus level. 
Awesome music by Suzanne Chesterton of Siskin (https://twitter.com/SuzChesterton)
Full Controller Support.

We would be most interested in comments/feedback positive and negative.

Depending on feedback we will be posting a full roadmap early March.
